prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE portrait 3:4 photorealistic premium product catalogue photograph for 128am Cafe. Exactly ONE earl grey matcha latte, no other drinks.
Reference roles: image 1 is cleaned MASTER, definitive for product identity, clean edges and thin syrup layer. Other reference images if provided only support camera angle and actual cup shape. Retain the actual short squat broad transparent plastic sundae cup, gently tapered round sides and rounded bottom, clear plastic DOME lid with circular opening at top. Retain original girl mascot sticker with brown hair and pink bow, white bunny with exactly TWO ears, compact 128am Cafe plaque lettering. Match sticker appearance, not a redesigned logo. Preserve green matcha upper drink, beige Earl Grey infused milk below with beautiful natural marbling and ice, white cold foam in soft gentle low mounds under dome, light matcha dust. Foam must stay INSIDE lid/cup with a visible clear space above; no tall whipped-cream tower.
CRITICAL: Thin continuous clearly visible AMBER-BROWN Earl Grey syrup band at very bottom, about 4–5 percent of liquid height, matching master. Never red syrup or pink strawberry. Cup outside, rim and outer lid flange are clean clear dry plastic, without overflow, green foam on outer lip, smears, drips, splashes or wet mess. Preserve appetising true tea colours and realistic plastic refraction. No new toppings or fictional ingredients.
Typography: exact lowercase title "earl grey matcha latte", usually two lines "earl grey" then "matcha latte", in large friendly rounded bold Fredoka-style rose #B8496C. Small cocoa brown "128am Cafe". Generous margins, full cup and whole dome visible with bottom syrup unobscured. Palette cream #FFF8F5, rose #B8496C, blush #FDE5EB, sage #E7F0DC. No price, claims, captions, watermark, other text, straw, hands or illustrated drink. Professional commercial food photography, not a 3D render.
Scene/composition: fresh two-tone editorial studio photograph. Seamless pale sage #E7F0DC backdrop on the left and soft blush #FDE5EB on the right meet in a straight vertical seam slightly off centre; cream tabletop below. One Earl Grey matcha cup upright in front, large and centred in lower two thirds, full dome and amber syrup bottom visible. Professional real paper photography backdrops, soft physical texture, warm diffused side lighting, delicate contact shadow. Both coloured planes subdued enough to support large rose two-line title in upper third and small cocoa brand beneath; keep title readable, not cut by high contrast. No extra props. Sophisticated clean café catalogue composition, photorealistic.
